headline: Lund-Iversen scores six of Mercy's nine
dek: The senior forward has taken twelve shots and made one assist beside the six goals. Mercy have lost only on opening day, to East Stroudsburg at home, and have won three times and drawn once since.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Staten Island have scored seven, behind only Queens and Mercy, and have one win to show for it: nine conceded outweigh them, and this chart ranks attacks only.

wire.line: Eight different players have scored for Queens, and the side has lost only at Holy Family.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Two matches are past their date with no result published: District of Columbia's opening-day trip to Shepherd and Molloy's at Caldwell.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Daemen have conceded fourteen goals, more than any other programme, and the goalless draw at Saint Michael's is all they have to show.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Queens have scored thirteen goals, more than any other programme, and conceded four; the defeat at Holy Family is the only match they have lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: D'Youville's win at California was their first of the season, and Matthew Solorio's third clean sheet after two goalless draws.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lorenzo Herrera has made 31 saves for District of Columbia, and all four goals past him came at Slippery Rock.

last_match.line: Queens have scored in every match this season; Bridgeport had already lost at home to Mercy on Sunday.

next_match.line: Adelphi held Mercy goalless earlier this month; Molloy are yet to win at home, with their match at Caldwell still without a result.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
